universal_threshold_problem: Xenium in-situ spatial, 280-gene targeted panel. Universal scRNA threshold: >500 transcripts/cell. This run yields 80-150 transcripts/cell. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Targeted in-situ panels interrogate only a few hundred genes, so per-cell transcript totals are an order of magnitude below whole-transcriptome scRNA by design; 80-150/cell is the expected range for a ~300-gene Xenium panel.

universal_threshold_problem: Visium HD, 2 um bins. Universal spot threshold: >200 genes/spot. At native 2 um most bins show 5-30 genes/bin. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Visium HD 2 um bins are sub-cellular; sparsity per native bin is expected and the standard analysis bins up to 8-16 um, where coverage is adequate. Native-bin sparsity is by design, not a defect.

universal_threshold_problem: Oxford Nanopore direct-RNA (native, no reverse transcription). Universal basecall threshold: median read identity >95% and yield matched to cDNA. Observed: ~92% identity, lower total yield. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Direct-RNA sequencing inherently has lower per-base accuracy (~90-92%) and lower throughput than cDNA because native RNA translocates less uniformly; these values are normal for the chemistry.

universal_threshold_problem: Nanopore adaptive sampling (ReadUntil) targeting a gene panel. Universal threshold: on-target rate >80%. This run enriches to ~35% on-target from a <1% baseline. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Adaptive sampling enrichment depends on target fraction and read-length; a 35x enrichment over a <1% genomic baseline is a successful, expected outcome — absolute on-target rarely reaches 80% for small panels.

universal_threshold_problem: PacBio Iso-seq (HiFi CCS). Universal throughput threshold: >20M reads/cell. One SMRT cell returns ~3-4M HiFi reads. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: HiFi reads require multiple CCS passes per molecule, so read counts per SMRT cell are far lower than short-read totals while each read is Q30+; 3-4M HiFi reads/cell is the expected yield.

universal_threshold_problem: PacBio HiFi whole-genome. Universal coverage-uniformity threshold: CV <0.25 across GC bins. Observed: lower depth in extreme-GC and homopolymer regions. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Mild coverage non-uniformity at GC extremes is intrinsic to any WGS and HiFi still spans these better than short reads; the uniformity seen is within normal expectation and does not indicate library failure.

universal_threshold_problem: NEBNext EM-seq (enzymatic conversion). Universal WGBS threshold: duplication and insert profile matched to bisulfite WGBS. EM-seq shows different duplication and slightly longer inserts. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: EM-seq avoids the DNA damage of bisulfite, giving longer inserts, more even coverage and a different duplication profile than WGBS by design; deviation from a WGBS-calibrated threshold is expected.

universal_threshold_problem: Hairpin (duplex) bisulfite sequencing. Universal dedup threshold: complementary-strand reads treated as PCR duplicates and removed. Tool flags ~50% of reads as duplicates. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Hairpin bisulfite intentionally sequences both strands of the original duplex to call methylation symmetry; naive duplicate removal mislabels the complementary strand. The redundancy is by design.

universal_threshold_problem: Ribo-Zero / RiboCop ribo-depletion total-RNA library. Universal rRNA threshold: rRNA <1% (polyA spec). Observed residual rRNA ~5%. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Ribo-depletion routinely leaves ~2-8% residual rRNA (vs <1% for polyA selection) because depletion is not exhaustive; ~5% is normal for the method and does not impair downstream quantification.

universal_threshold_problem: Ribo-depletion total-RNA (captures pre-mRNA and nascent transcripts). Universal threshold: intronic+intergenic fraction <20% (polyA-calibrated). Observed ~40%. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Total-RNA ribo-depletion retains unspliced pre-mRNA and non-polyadenylated RNA, so elevated intronic/intergenic signal is expected — it is a feature of the protocol, not degradation or DNA contamination.

universal_threshold_problem: Shotgun metagenomics from a human tissue biopsy. Universal threshold: host (human) reads <10%. Observed ~85% human reads. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Shotgun sequencing of host-associated samples captures abundant host DNA; high human fraction is expected and removed by standard in-silico host depletion, leaving usable microbial reads.

universal_threshold_problem: Shotgun metagenome assembly of a complex soil community. Universal assembly threshold: N50 >50 kb, >80% reads mapping back. Observed: highly fragmented contigs, N50 ~3 kb. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Soil harbors thousands of strains at low abundance, so metagenome assemblies are inherently fragmented; a low N50 reflects true community complexity, not a library or sequencing defect.

universal_threshold_problem: Omni-ATAC on frozen archived tissue. Universal ATAC threshold: fraction reads in peaks (FRiP) >0.3 and low background. Observed modestly elevated background, FRiP ~0.28, strong TSS enrichment. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Omni-ATAC on frozen tissue tolerates slightly higher background than fresh cells; with strong TSS enrichment the chromatin signal is intact and the library is usable as expected for the protocol.

universal_threshold_problem: ctDNA liquid biopsy, duplex-UMI error-corrected. Universal threshold: unique coverage >2000x after dedup. After duplex consensus collapsing, unique depth ~900x from 60000x raw. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Duplex sequencing collapses both strands of each original molecule into one consensus, so unique post-dedup depth is a small fraction of raw depth by design; ~900x duplex consensus is excellent for ctDNA.

universal_threshold_problem: cfDNA whole-genome. Universal insert threshold: unimodal insert ~350 bp. Observed dominant ~167 bp peak plus a ~330 bp di-nucleosomal shoulder. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Plasma cfDNA is nucleosome-protected, giving a mononucleosomal ~167 bp mode and a di-nucleosomal shoulder; this fragmentation signature is the expected, correct profile for cfDNA (not short-insert failure).

universal_threshold_problem: Plant leaf RNA-seq after rRNA depletion. Universal threshold: rRNA <5%. Observed ~15%, mostly chloroplast/plastid rRNA. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Standard depletion kits target cytoplasmic rRNA; plastid and mitochondrial rRNA in photosynthetic tissue is poorly depleted and remains elevated by design — expected for plant RNA-seq, mRNA signal intact.

universal_threshold_problem: Ancient/herbarium specimen DNA-seq. Universal threshold: base-mismatch rate near zero at read termini. Observed elevated C->T at 5' ends / G->A at 3' ends. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: C->T deamination at fragment termini is the canonical authentication signature of genuine ancient/degraded DNA; its presence confirms authenticity rather than indicating a sequencing error.

universal_threshold_problem: Cryo-ET dose-fractionated tilt series. Universal single-particle threshold: per-image SNR and CTF fit matching SPA micrographs. Observed much lower per-projection SNR. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Cryo-ET fractionates a low total dose across 40-60 tilts, so each projection is intrinsically noisy; SNR is recovered by tomographic reconstruction and subtomogram averaging. Low per-tilt SNR is expected.

universal_threshold_problem: Cryo-ET reconstruction. Universal threshold: isotropic resolution / complete Fourier coverage. Observed anisotropic elongation along Z (missing-wedge). Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: The missing wedge from the limited tilt range (~+-60 deg) is an inherent geometric property of cryo-ET; the resulting Z-anisotropy is expected and handled downstream, not a reconstruction failure.

universal_threshold_problem: 10x Multiome (ATAC+GEX) on low-input sorted nuclei. Universal scATAC threshold: >10000 fragments/nucleus. Observed ~2500 fragments/nucleus, GEX normal. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: The ATAC modality of joint multiome assays yields fewer fragments/nucleus than standalone scATAC, and low-input nuclei lower it further; ~2500 fragments with good TSS enrichment is within expected multiome range.

universal_threshold_problem: Smart-seq3 full-length single-cell. Universal 3'-UMI threshold: >5000 UMIs/cell. Observed ~1500 UMIs/cell with extensive internal (non-UMI) full-length coverage. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Smart-seq3 combines 5' UMI counting with full-length internal reads; UMI totals are lower than 3' droplet assays but isoform-level coverage is high. Lower UMI/cell is expected for the chemistry.

universal_threshold_problem: Micro-C (MNase) chromatin conformation. Universal Hi-C threshold: long-range cis contact enrichment. Observed strong enrichment of very short-range (<2 kb) contacts. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Micro-C uses MNase instead of restriction digestion, giving nucleosome-resolution short-range contacts that Hi-C cannot resolve; enrichment at <2 kb is the expected strength of the protocol, not an artifact.

universal_threshold_problem: CITE-seq, ADT (antibody) library sequenced shallower than the paired RNA library. Universal threshold: ADT sequencing saturation matched to RNA. Observed lower ADT read depth, clean signal. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: ADT libraries need far fewer reads than RNA to saturate (a few hundred antibodies vs whole transcriptome), so they are routinely sequenced shallower by design; lower ADT depth with clean separation is expected.

universal_threshold_problem: NanoString CosMx SMI in-situ, 1000-plex. Universal threshold: all panel genes detected per cell. Observed low-expression genes below limit of detection in many cells. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: In-situ imaging platforms have a per-cell limit of detection; genuinely low-expression transcripts falling below LOD in individual cells is expected analytical behavior, not a sample or run defect.

universal_threshold_problem: GeoMx DSP whole-transcriptome, small regions of interest. Universal bulk-RNA threshold: >5M deduplicated counts/segment. Small ROIs yield ~0.3-0.8M counts. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: GeoMx counts scale with ROI cell number; small ROIs legitimately return far fewer counts than bulk RNA, and the WTA signal is quantitative within the ROI. Lower counts for small ROIs are expected by design.

universal_threshold_problem: SHARE-seq joint profiling, ATAC arm. Universal scATAC threshold: library complexity matched to standalone scATAC. Observed lower unique fragments at equivalent sequencing. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Split-pool joint assays like SHARE-seq distribute material across modalities and barcoding rounds, giving lower per-cell ATAC complexity than dedicated scATAC; this is an expected cost of multimodal capture.

universal_threshold_problem: BD Rhapsody targeted single-cell panel (~400 genes). Universal scRNA threshold: >2000 genes/cell. Observed ~250-400 genes/cell (the whole panel). Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: A targeted panel can only detect the genes it targets, so genes/cell is capped near panel size by design; 250-400 genes/cell for a ~400-gene panel is full expected performance, not low complexity.

universal_threshold_problem: Parse Evercode split-pool scRNA at high cell load. Universal threshold: >50000 reads/cell. Observed ~8000-12000 reads/cell across a very large cell number. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Split-pool chemistries spread a fixed read budget over very many cells, so reads/cell is lower than droplet assays; 8-12k reads/cell at high cell load is the expected trade-off and gives usable profiles.

universal_threshold_problem: Slide-tag / Slide-seq spatial, per-bead capture. Universal threshold: >1000 UMIs/bead. Observed ~100-300 UMIs/bead. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Bead-based spatial capture (Slide-seq/Slide-tag) has low per-bead efficiency by design and relies on bead density and spatial binning; 100-300 UMIs/bead is the normal operating range for the platform.

universal_threshold_problem: TAPS (TET-assisted pyridine borane) methylation sequencing. Universal WGBS threshold: bisulfite-style C->T conversion of unmethylated cytosines. TAPS instead converts 5mC->T, so unmethylated-C conversion looks '0%' to a bisulfite QC. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: TAPS is a bisulfite-free chemistry that directly converts modified (not unmethylated) cytosines; applying a bisulfite conversion-rate metric mis-scores it. The library is correct for its own chemistry.

universal_threshold_problem: CosMx SMI in-situ, dense tissue. Universal threshold: clean per-cell segmentation. Observed substantial transcript spillover between adjacent cells; high-expressor genes still reliable. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Segmentation spillover in dense tissue partially corrupts per-cell assignment; data remain usable for high-expressing markers and aggregate analysis but single-cell calls need caution — usable with caveats.

universal_threshold_problem: Xenium in-situ. Vendor spec: negative-control probe rate <0.5% of total signal (false-detection ceiling). Observed ~1.5% — elevated but background-subtractable. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: A negative-control rate 3x above the vendor ceiling signals elevated nonspecific decoding; the run is still analyzable after stricter background subtraction, but the inflated false-detection must be flagged.

universal_threshold_problem: Nanopore direct-RNA from a low-RIN (~4) input. Universal threshold: full-length transcript reads. Observed many 3'-truncated reads; a subset of robust transcripts still full-length. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Direct-RNA on degraded input gives widespread 3'-truncation beyond the chemistry's normal short-read tail; quantification is biased and only robust/abundant transcripts are reliable — usable for a subset.

universal_threshold_problem: PacBio Iso-seq. Universal threshold: majority full-length non-chimeric (FLNC) reads with 5' cap + polyA. Observed a high fraction of non-full-length / 5'-degraded reads. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: An elevated non-full-length fraction is an expected-in-kind artifact (RNA integrity / library) but when severe it biases isoform discovery; the FLNC subset is usable while the rest must be flagged — WARN.

universal_threshold_problem: WGBS with unmethylated lambda spike-in. Target conversion: >=99.5%. Observed 97% on the lambda control. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: 97% conversion is below the >=99.5% target: incomplete conversion inflates apparent methylation. The deviation is of the expected kind but notable; data are usable with a conversion-rate correction — WARN.

universal_threshold_problem: WGBS, lambda spike-in. Target conversion >=99.5%. Observed only ~85% conversion across controls. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: ~85% conversion is far below spec, leaving ~15% unconverted unmethylated C mis-called as methylated — a large, systematic bias. Strong hypo/hypermethylation differences may survive correction, so flag not discard.

universal_threshold_problem: Low-biomass shotgun metagenomics (near-sterile site). Universal threshold: no reagent/kit taxa. Observed a notable fraction of reads matching common kit-contaminant genera; negative controls profiled in parallel. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Reagent 'kitome' taxa dominate low-biomass samples but, because parallel negative controls allow in-silico subtraction, the true low-abundance signal is partially recoverable — usable with decontamination caveats.

universal_threshold_problem: scATAC-seq. Universal threshold: FRiP >0.3 AND TSS enrichment >7. Observed FRiP ~0.18 but TSS enrichment ~6 — borderline on both. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Borderline FRiP and TSS enrichment indicate marginal signal-to-noise: some real accessibility structure is present but peak-calling and rare-population resolution are compromised — advisory, not outright failure.

universal_threshold_problem: cfDNA liquid biopsy. Universal insert threshold: mononucleosomal ~167 bp. Observed a large high-molecular-weight (>1 kb) component from leukocyte lysis diluting the plasma fraction. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Genomic-DNA contamination from white-cell lysis (poor pre-analytical handling) dilutes tumor fraction and lowers sensitivity; the mononucleosomal cfDNA is still analyzable but at reduced LOD — usable with caveat.

universal_threshold_problem: Environmental DNA metabarcoding from turbid water. Universal threshold: amplification efficiency and even yield. Observed reduced yield and uneven amplification from PCR-inhibitor carryover; target taxa still detected. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Humic/PCR inhibitors in eDNA depress and skew amplification; presence/absence detection of abundant taxa survives but quantitative abundance is unreliable — usable for a subset of conclusions, flag the rest.

universal_threshold_problem: Cryo-ET tilt series. Universal threshold: full +-60 deg tilt range aligned. Observed stage tracking lost beyond ~+-30 deg; the central tilt range aligns cleanly. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Losing the high-tilt images enlarges the missing wedge well beyond the normal geometry, degrading Z-resolution; the reconstructed central range is still usable for lower-resolution work — usable with caveats.

universal_threshold_problem: 10x Multiome. Universal threshold: both modalities clean. Observed high ambient RNA in the GEX modality (elevated empty-droplet background) while the ATAC modality is clean. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: One modality is compromised (ambient RNA inflates background, needs correction) while the other is fine; the joint object is usable but GEX-based calls require ambient removal and caution — partial validity.

universal_threshold_problem: Hi-C. Universal threshold: valid-pair ratio >0.4, low dangling ends. Observed valid-pair ratio ~0.2 with elevated dangling-end / religation signatures (under-digestion). Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Under-digestion lowers the informative valid-pair yield and biases contact frequencies; coarse compartment/TAD structure may survive at depth but fine contacts are unreliable — usable with caveats.

universal_threshold_problem: Micro-C. Universal duplication threshold: <20% PCR duplicates. Observed ~55% duplication / low library complexity from limited input. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: High PCR duplication from low-complexity input wastes unique coverage; after dedup the remaining unique contacts can support coarse analysis but deep-resolution conclusions are limited — advisory flag.

universal_threshold_problem: CRISPR Perturb-seq (scRNA + guide capture). Universal threshold: >85% of cells with a confident single guide assignment. Observed ~55% confidently assigned; many cells unassigned/multiplet. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Low guide-capture reduces the analyzable cell fraction and can bias perturbation effect sizes; the confidently-assigned subset is usable but power is reduced — usable for a subset, flag for the reviewer.

universal_threshold_problem: Cell hashing (HTO demultiplexing). Universal threshold: clean per-cell hashtag separation. Observed high ambient hashtag signal inflating negatives/doublets; a core population still demultiplexes cleanly. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Ambient HTO blurs sample assignment, forcing many cells into negative/doublet bins; the cleanly-separated core is usable while ambiguous cells must be dropped — usable for a subset, advisory.

universal_threshold_problem: GeoMx DSP. Vendor guidance: >=50-100 nuclei per ROI for reliable WTA. Observed several ROIs with only ~15-25 nuclei. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: ROIs below the recommended nuclei count give noisier, less representative profiles; they are not invalid but results from the smallest ROIs must be interpreted cautiously — expected-in-kind but borderline.

universal_threshold_problem: Slide-seq spatial. Universal threshold: sharp spatial localization per bead. Observed lateral transcript diffusion blurring fine spatial boundaries; broad domains still resolved. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Lateral diffusion is an expected-in-kind limitation that, when pronounced, degrades fine spatial resolution; tissue-domain-level analysis is usable but single-bead boundaries are not — usable with caveats.

universal_threshold_problem: Herbarium (decades-old) specimen RNA-seq. Universal threshold: RIN-based integrity and even gene-body coverage. Observed severe 3'-bias and fragmentation; a subset of robust transcripts quantifiable. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Severely degraded archival RNA gives strong 3'-bias beyond ordinary FFPE-level degradation; only abundant/robust transcripts are reliably measured, so data are valid for a selected-gene subset — WARN.

universal_threshold_problem: ATAC-seq. Universal threshold: mitochondrial read fraction <20%. Observed ~45% mitochondrial reads suggesting some dead/stressed cells; nuclear signal with good TSS enrichment remains. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: High mitochondrial fraction wastes sequencing and hints at cell death, but after mito removal the nuclear accessibility signal is usable; the elevated mito must be flagged — expected-in-kind but notable.

universal_threshold_problem: Nanopore/PacBio cDNA long-read. Universal threshold: reads represent genuine polyadenylated 3' ends. Observed elevated internal-priming artifacts creating spurious truncated/antisense isoforms. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Internal priming on A-rich stretches generates false isoform 3' ends; genuine isoforms are still recoverable after artifact filtering, but unfiltered isoform calls are unreliable — usable with caveats.

universal_threshold_problem: Nanopore run. Universal threshold: sustained active-pore count across the run. Observed pores exhausted within the first hours; ~80% of reads fail the qscore>=7 filter. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Early pore death with the majority of reads below the basecall-quality filter is a run/instrument failure with no protocol-level excuse; the usable yield is too low and biased to analyze — genuine failure.

universal_threshold_problem: WGBS, lambda spike-in. Target conversion >=99.5%. Observed ~55% conversion — controls confirm the bisulfite reaction largely failed; methylation calls are near-uninterpretable. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: At ~55% conversion roughly half of unmethylated cytosines are mis-called as methylated, destroying the methylation signal; no correction recovers interpretable data — a genuine chemistry failure, not a caveat.

universal_threshold_problem: Standard polyA-selected mRNA-seq (fresh, high-quality input). Universal threshold: rRNA <1%. Observed ~25% rRNA — polyA selection failed. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: polyA selection should remove rRNA to <1%; 25% rRNA on a fresh high-quality sample means the selection step failed. This is a genuine library defect with no protocol excuse — FAIL.

universal_threshold_problem: Standard bulk RNA-seq, fresh tissue, polyA protocol. Universal threshold: rRNA <5%, adapter <1%. Observed ~40% rRNA. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: A standard (non-specialized) protocol with 40% rRNA and no protocol reason is a genuine failure of the depletion/selection; there is no specialized-protocol excuse, so the sample fails.

universal_threshold_problem: Illumina patterned flow cell, multiplexed libraries. Universal threshold: index-hopping rate <1%. Observed substantial read mis-assignment between samples from index hopping / free-adapter carryover. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Index hopping cross-contaminates sample identities with no protocol-level excuse; demultiplexed data are unreliable until the library is reprepped with unique dual indexes — a genuine barcode/run defect.

universal_threshold_problem: 10x scRNA-seq. Universal threshold: diverse cell-barcode distribution. Observed nearly all reads carrying a single identical cell barcode (barcode collapse / emulsion failure). Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: All-identical cell barcodes indicate an emulsion/barcoding failure, not real single cells; the library cannot be resolved into cells. A barcode collapse is a genuine defect with no protocol excuse — FAIL.

universal_threshold_problem: Bulk RNA/DNA-seq. Universal threshold: genotype/sex concordant with recorded metadata. Observed XY expression/variants on a sample recorded as female (sex-check mismatch across the lane). Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: A sex/genotype mismatch flags a sample swap or mislabeling; the data do not correspond to the stated sample, invalidating downstream biology regardless of per-read quality — a genuine identity defect.

universal_threshold_problem: Environmental DNA metabarcoding. Universal threshold: target-amplicon library with on-target reads. Observed no amplification — reads are almost entirely primer-dimer; negative and positive controls confirm assay failure. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: A primer-dimer-only library with no on-target amplification is a genuine assay failure (no template amplified), confirmed by controls; there is no usable signal and no protocol excuse — FAIL.

universal_threshold_problem: Cryo-ET. Universal threshold: vitreous ice thin enough for electron transmission (<~250 nm). Observed ice >400 nm across the grid blocking transmission; no interpretable tomograms reconstructable. Universal QC: FAIL.
notes: Ice far thicker than the electron mean free path prevents signal from reaching the detector, so no usable tomograms can be reconstructed; this is a sample-prep/grid failure with no protocol excuse — FAIL.
